config_dir.description: Path to config directory; passed to -c/--config.

daemon_ip.description: Deluge daemon IP address (default 127.0.0.1); passed to -d/--daemon.

username.description: Username for daemon authentication; passed to -U/--username.

password.description: Password for daemon authentication; passed to -P/--password.

quiet.description: Enable quiet mode (same as loglevel=none); passed to -q/--quiet.

logrotate.description: Enable logfile rotation; optional max-size string (e.g., '2M') or true for default (2M). Passed to --logrotate[=max-size].

profile.description: Enable cProfile; optional output filename or true to output to stdout. Passed to --profile[=file].
